messages:
Priya Kapoor: Heads-up — CompassAI customer wants to run a POC to swap their inference from Compass -> Redwood. CTO flagged three deal blockers: prompt parity, pricing delta, and the security questionnaire. Can we triage?
Alex Chen: I can own the prompt/response parity checks. quick Q: do they use streaming + tool-calls?
Priya Kapoor: They do streaming for chat and use a thin proxy mapping Compass' /v1/chat to their product. Also use a vendor-side LRO for reranks.
Samir Patel: On parity — biggest gotchas we usually see: different message role names, extra metadata fields in choices, and subtle tokenization differences if they used bespoke tiktoken version. we should capture a few canonical prompts and run them through both models.
Jordan Lee: I'll coordinate with the customer for a test harness. prefer a small matrix: 10 prompts (3 few-shot, 4 instruction-following, 3 edge-case system prompts). timeline?
Priya Kapoor: Need results within 7 business days for their exec demo.
Alex Chen: Sounds doable. I'll spin up a dedicated route on staging with the Compass-compat proxy enabled. mapping notes: Compass expects `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and `model: compass-large` body. Our proxy will accept the same payload and translate to Redwood model param + route.
Alex Chen: Example curl they run now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.compass.ai/v1/chat \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer COMPASS-KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"compass-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain reducers"}]}'
```
Alex Chen: On Redwood we want:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-70b","input":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain reducers"}]}'
```
Casey Morgan: Security side — they sent a 43-question vendor questionnaire (attachments in thread). immediate asks: SOC2 scope, KMS integrations, VPC peering, and subprocessor list. We need to fill the SAML + audit log parts for enterprise.
sec-bot: [automated] Form link uploaded: https://redwood-internal/docs/sec/questionnaires/compass-poc-2026.
Priya Kapoor: Pricing question from procurement: "If traffic hits 1.5x during demo week, what rate/discount applies?" Also they asked about token billing parity vs Compass (Compass bills per chunked response).
Jordan Lee: For POC we can offer trial credits and a temporary burst policy on Dedicated. need approval from finance for explicit burst pricing.
Alex Chen: Technical note — response shape diff: Compass embeds `choices[].message.content` + `usage` they include `prompt_tokens` and `completion_tokens`. Redwood returns `outputs[]` with `text` and `metrics.total_tokens`. We'll add a proxy layer that emits a Compass-shaped response to avoid app changes. small mapping snippet I'll push to the staging proxy repo.
Samir Patel: Also watch for rerank LROs — they call a second endpoint for rerank scoring expecting stable IDs. our IDs differ; proxy should preserve or map IDs so client-side logic doesn't break.
Casey Morgan: For KMS: they require that keys be customer-managed (not vendor-shared). We support AWS KMS + GCP KMS in Private deployments; for Hosted we can do envelope encryption with customer KMS in VPC. I'll draft a statement for the questionnaire.
Priya Kapoor: Any enterprise SLA comments? they want 99.95 and clarifications around maintenance windows.
Jordan Lee: Dedicated pool + SLA addendum works. I'll loop Legal for the APL.
Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Samir + Alex run parity matrix (due EOD +5). 2) Jordan coordinate prompts + demo plan (due EOD +2). 3) Casey to draft security answers + KMS options (due EOD +3). 4) Priya to confirm burst pricing ask with finance (due EOD +1).
Priya Kapoor: Thanks — I'll ping the customer and set the kickoff call tomorrow 10am PT. anyone want to join the 15m tech sync?
Alex Chen: I'll be there.
Samir Patel: count me in.
Casey Morgan: I'll join the security portion.
Jordan Lee: I'll run the demo script.
Priya Kapoor: Great. keeping thread here for status updates — please post short check-ins. :thumbsup:
